howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你为 plant-store-api CLI 编写自定义命令，包括编辑 custom.rs 文件、注册命令、使用 SDK 客户端，并解释构建与运行方法。
howto.when: 当你请教如何为 plant-store-api 添加自定义命令时，Claude 会使用本指南。

say.text: 帮我在 plant-store-api 里加一个按ID查询植物的自定义命令。
say.note: Claude 会给出 custom.rs 代码和构建指令。

say.text: 教我如何为 plant-store-api 编写并注册自定义命令。
say.note: Claude 会讲解流程并给出示例。

say.text: 在 custom.rs 里添加一个命令，参数是name，返回一条消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to write custom commands for the plant-store-api CLI, including editing custom.rs, registering commands, using the SDK client, and explaining build and run steps.
howto.when_en: When you ask how to add custom commands to plant-store-api, Claude uses this guide.

say_en.text: Add a custom command to plant-store-api that queries a plant by ID.
say_en.note: Claude provides code and build instructions.

say_en.text: Show me how to write and register a custom command for plant-store-api.
say_en.note: Claude explains the process with an example.

say_en.text: Add a command in custom.rs that takes 'name' as argument and prints a message.
